tropes.name: Non-Linear Timeline
tropes.description: Narrative unfolds out of chronological sequence, challenging temporal perception.

tropes.name: Time Dilation
tropes.description: Gravitational or relativistic physics alter the perceived flow of elapsed time.

tropes.name: Sentient AI
tropes.description: Autonomous artificial consciousness interrogates human existential purpose.

tropes.name: Unreliable Narrator
tropes.description: The perspective storyteller compromises objective reality through delusion or deceit.

tropes.name: Morally Ambiguous Antihero
tropes.description: Protagonist operates outside conventional ethical paradigms for complex justice.

tropes.name: Heist
tropes.description: A high-stakes tactical mission requiring precision coordination against impossible odds.

tropes.name: Multiverse
tropes.description: Infinite parallel realities intersecting through ontological choices.

tropes.name: Cosmic Dread
tropes.description: Human insignificance confronted against unfathomable universal forces.

tropes.name: Neo-Noir
tropes.description: Shadowy urban underworlds steeped in moral cynicism and rain-slicked neon.

tropes.name: Chosen One
tropes.description: A messianic figure burdened with shifting the fate of civilization.

tropes.name: Doppelgänger
tropes.description: The psychological terror of encountering one's mirrored self.

tropes.name: Surrealism
tropes.description: Dream logic and poetic abstraction supplant linear realism.

tropes.name: Social Stratification
tropes.description: Economic division and architecture reflect class warfare.

tropes.name: In-Yun Destiny
tropes.description: Soul connections recurring and reverberating across lifetimes.

tropes.name: Simulated Reality
tropes.description: Perceived existence is an artificial construct engineered to deceive.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.plotSummary: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
movies.tagline: Long live the fighters.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.plotSummary: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb.
movies.tagline: The world forever changes.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.plotSummary: When Earth becomes uninhabitable, a team of ex-NASA pilots travel through a wormhole across the galaxy to find a new home.
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

movies.title: Inception
movies.plotSummary: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into a CEO's mind.
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.plotSummary: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological tests.
movies.tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.plotSummary: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard.
movies.tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
movies.plotSummary: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes.
movies.tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.plotSummary: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.
movies.tagline: Welcome to the Real World.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.plotSummary: After a tragic accident, two stage magicians in 1890s London engage in a battle to create the ultimate illusion while sacrificing everything.
movies.tagline: Are you watching closely?

movies.title: The Departed
movies.plotSummary: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.
movies.tagline: Lies. Betrayal. Sacrifice. How far will you take it?

movies.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.plotSummary: The early life and career of Vito Corleone in 1920s New York City is portrayed, while his son, Michael, expands the family syndicate.
movies.tagline: All the power on earth can't change destiny.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.plotSummary: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.
movies.tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean that you have character.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.plotSummary: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence.
movies.tagline: It's how you wear the mask that matters.

movies.title: Arrival
movies.plotSummary: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after twelve mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.
movies.tagline: Why are they here?

movies.title: Parasite
movies.plotSummary: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.
movies.tagline: Act like you own the place.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.plotSummary: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing.
movies.tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.

movies.title: Fight Club
movies.plotSummary: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into much more.
movies.tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.

movies.title: Se7en
movies.plotSummary: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.
movies.tagline: Seven deadly sins. Seven ways to die.

movies.title: Goodfellas
movies.plotSummary: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife and his mob partners.
movies.tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.

movies.title: Past Lives
movies.plotSummary: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea.
movies.tagline: In-Yun: the destiny of souls meeting across lifetimes.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.plotSummary: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits.
movies.tagline: The tunnel led Chihiro to a mysterious world.

movies.title: Heat
movies.plotSummary: A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the LAPD on their tails when they unknowingly leave a clue at their latest heist.
movies.tagline: A Los Angeles crime saga.

movies.title: Dunkirk
movies.plotSummary: Allied soldiers from Belgium, the British Commonwealth and Empire, and France are surrounded by the German Army and evacuated during World War II.
movies.tagline: When 400,000 men couldn't get home, home came for them.

movies.title: Shutter Island
movies.plotSummary: In 1954, a U.S. Marshal investigates the disappearance of a murderer who escaped from a hospital for the criminally insane.
movies.tagline: Someone is missing.

movies.title: Alien
movies.plotSummary: The crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform after investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin.
movies.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

movies.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
movies.plotSummary: A cyborg, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced cyborg.
movies.tagline: It's nothing personal.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.plotSummary: A pragmatic paleontologist touring an almost complete theme park on an island in Central America is tasked with protecting kids when cloned dinosaurs run loose.
movies.tagline: An adventure 65 million years in the making.

movies.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
movies.plotSummary: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a cocky pilot, a Wookiee and two droids to save the galaxy from the Empire.
movies.tagline: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...

movies.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.plotSummary: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring.
movies.tagline: One ring to rule them all.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.plotSummary: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.
movies.tagline: What we do in life echoes in eternity.

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.plotSummary: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant youngest son.
movies.tagline: An offer you can't refuse.

movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.plotSummary: Over the course of several years, two convicts form a friendship, seeking solace and eventual redemption through basic compassion.
movies.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.

movies.title: Schindler's List
movies.plotSummary: In German-occupied Poland during WWII, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution.
movies.tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.

movies.title: 12 Angry Men
movies.plotSummary: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty of murder.
movies.tagline: Life is in their hands. Death is on their minds.

movies.title: The Return of the King
movies.plotSummary: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom.
movies.tagline: The eye of the enemy is moving.

movies.title: The Empire Strikes Back
movies.plotSummary: After the Rebels are brutally overpowered by the Empire, Luke Skywalker begins Jedi training with Yoda while his friends are pursued by Darth Vader.
movies.tagline: The adventure continues...

movies.title: Forrest Gump
movies.plotSummary: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds through the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75.
movies.tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.

movies.title: The Silence of the Lambs
movies.plotSummary: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer.
movies.tagline: To enter the mind of a killer you must challenge the mind of a madman.

movies.title: Saving Private Ryan
movies.plotSummary: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.
movies.tagline: The mission is a man.

movies.title: City of God
movies.plotSummary: In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge: one struggles to become a photographer, while the other becomes a ruthless kingpin.
movies.tagline: If you run away, the beast catches you; if you stay, the beast eats you.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.plotSummary: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their aspirations.
movies.tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.

movies.title: Dune
movies.plotSummary: A noble family becomes embroiled in a war for control over the galaxy's most valuable asset while its heir is troubled by visions of a dark future.
movies.tagline: It begins.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.plotSummary: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat.
movies.tagline: More than one can wear the mask.

movies.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.plotSummary: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong and more than two million dollars near the Rio Grande.
movies.tagline: There are no clean escapes.

movies.title: The Truman Show
movies.plotSummary: An insurance salesman discovers his whole life is actually a reality TV show broadcast live 24/7 across the globe.
movies.tagline: On the air. Unaware.

movies.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
movies.plotSummary: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories.
movies.tagline: You can erase someone from your mind. Getting them out of your heart is another story.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.plotSummary: A writer encounters the owner of a high-class European hotel who tells of his early years as a lobby boy in the hotel's glorious heyday.
movies.tagline: A film by Wes Anderson.

movies.title: Her
movies.plotSummary: In a near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.
movies.tagline: A Spike Jonze love story.

movies.title: Inglourious Basterds
movies.plotSummary: In Nazi-occupied France during WWII, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plot.
movies.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi-occupied France...

movies.title: Django Unchained
movies.plotSummary: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
movies.tagline: Life, liberty and the pursuit of vengeance.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.plotSummary: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners and a drifter.
movies.tagline: What a lovely day.

movies.title: Ex Machina
movies.plotSummary: A young programmer is selected to participate in a ground-breaking experiment in synthetic intelligence by evaluating the human qualities of a highly advanced humanoid A.I.
movies.tagline: To erase the line between man and machine is to obscure the line between men and gods.
